intro_zh: 比较不是只写 A is bigger than B。先看比什么：数值高低（higher / lower than）、倍数（twice as much as）、差距大到不能忽略（significantly less than、exceed、lag behind）、几乎一样（on a par with）。两组数字一一对应时用 respectively；排名第二紧咬第一用 closely followed by。选错结构，数字再准也会显得别扭。
intro_en: The structures for putting two or more numbers side by side.

expressions.head: higher than
expressions.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure

examples.en: East finished at 690, higher than South at 452.
examples.zh: 东部最后收在 690，高于南部的 452。

examples.en: My electricity bill is higher than last winter because I run a heater all day.
examples.zh: 今年冬天的电费比去年高，因为我整天开暖气。

expressions.contrast_zh: 最基础的比较，只讲两边谁大；差距大就加 much / significantly，差距小加 slightly。和 exceed 的句式不同：higher than 把两个数并排放，exceed 用 A exceeds B。

expressions.head: lower than

examples.en: Aurora's 24 percent share in 2026 was lower than Nova's 27.
examples.zh: 2026 年 Aurora 24% 的份额低于 Nova 的 27%。

examples.en: This month's takeout spending is lower than last month because I cooked more.
examples.zh: 这个月外卖花得比上个月少，因为我自己做饭多了。

expressions.contrast_zh: higher than 的反面，同样只比较大小；口语里更常说 less than，但接具体数字时 lower than 更自然。差距大小靠 slightly / much 调节。

expressions.head: slightly more than
expressions.pattern: A + be + slightly more than + B

examples.en: South's final-quarter sales were slightly more than West's, 452 against 415.
examples.zh: 南部最后一个季度的销售额略高于西部，452 对 415。

examples.en: The new plan costs slightly more than the old one, but it includes storage.
examples.zh: 新套餐比旧套餐贵一点，但包含了存储空间。

expressions.contrast_zh: 比 higher than 更精确，直接说明差距小；slightly 只修饰幅度，不修饰速度。差距明显时换成 significantly more than，不要硬用 slightly。

expressions.head: significantly less than
expressions.pattern: A + be + significantly less than + B

examples.en: The Basic plan's integrations score was significantly less than the Pro plan's, 40 against 90.
examples.zh: 基础套餐的集成评分明显低于专业套餐，40 对 90。

examples.en: The team spent significantly less time on meetings after switching to written updates.
examples.zh: 改用文字汇报之后，团队开会的时间明显少了。

expressions.contrast_zh: significantly 表示差距大到不能忽略；口语里 far less than 更自然。注意 less 用于不可数或抽象量，可数个数要改用 fewer。

expressions.head: twice as much as
expressions.pattern: A + be + twice as much as + B / twice the + noun
collocations: twice as much as last year
more than twice as much as

examples.en: East's sales of 690 were more than twice North's 334.
examples.zh: 东部的 690 销售额是北部 334 的两倍多。

examples.en: I pay twice as much for rent as I did in my hometown.
examples.zh: 我现在的房租是老家那边的两倍。

expressions.contrast_zh: 专门说倍数；不可数量用 as much as，可数数量用 twice as many as。两倍多一点时加 more than，不要写 almost twice 却配一个超过两倍的数字。

expressions.head: three times as high as
expressions.pattern: A + be + three times as high as + B

examples.en: In 2026, Nova's 27 percent share was more than three times as high as Orbit's 8 percent.
examples.zh: 2026 年，Nova 27% 的份额是 Orbit 8% 的三倍多。

examples.en: Housing prices near the subway are almost three times as high as those two stops farther out.
examples.zh: 地铁旁的房价几乎是往外两站那些房子的三倍。

expressions.contrast_zh: 倍数结构要和形容词一致：as high as 配价格、比率这类高度，as many as 配可数个数。倍数前面可以加 more than / almost / about。三倍是 three times，不是 three times more。

expressions.head: exceed
expressions.pattern: A + exceed + B / exceed + amount / exceed expectations

examples.en: The Pro plan's storage score of 92 exceeds the Basic plan's 55.
examples.zh: 专业套餐的存储评分 92 超过基础套餐的 55。

examples.en: Revenue exceeded the $190K target in the last two weeks of March.
examples.zh: 三月最后两周，收入超过了 19 万美元的目标。

expressions.contrast_zh: 正式，常用于数字、目标、预期；口语更常说 be more than 或 beat。exceed 后面直接接宾语，不需要 than：exceed 90，不说 exceed than 90。

expressions.head: outperform
expressions.pattern: A + outperform + B + on + metric / by + amount

examples.en: The Pro plan outperformed the Basic plan on storage, 92 to 55.
examples.zh: 专业套餐在存储上以 92 对 55 胜过基础套餐。

examples.en: The small team outperformed the bigger one because decisions were faster.
examples.zh: 小团队因为决策更快，表现超过了更大的团队。

expressions.contrast_zh: 不只比数字大小，而是“整体表现更好”，常用于公司、产品、市场；单纯数值高低用 higher than 就够了，别把 outperform 用在两个普通数字上。

expressions.head: lag behind
expressions.pattern: A + lag behind + B / lag behind in + area

examples.en: North lagged behind the other three regions, with 334 in the final quarter.
examples.zh: 北部落后于其他三个地区，最后一个季度只有 334。

examples.en: The app lags behind its rivals on battery life, not on features.
examples.zh: 这款应用在电池续航上落后于对手，功能上并不差。

expressions.contrast_zh: 强调差距和跟不上，常带一点负面评价；lower than 只是客观说低，lag behind 更像在评价表现。

expressions.head: on a par with
expressions.pattern: A + be + on a par with + B
collocations: on a par with last year

examples.en: Kestrel was on a par with Vertex at 15 percent in 2026.
examples.zh: 2026 年，Kestrel 和 Vertex 持平，都是 15%。

examples.en: The new laptop's battery life is on a par with the more expensive model.
examples.zh: 这台新笔记本的续航和更贵的那款不相上下。

expressions.contrast_zh: 正式，表示水平接近或相等，不是完全一样；数据确实相等更适合 the same as，on a par with 更常用于能力、质量、表现。

expressions.head: respectively
expressions.pattern: A and B + verb + X and Y + respectively

examples.en: East and South started the period at 420 and 310 respectively.
examples.zh: 东部和南部期初分别是 420 和 310。

examples.en: My sister and I pay 4,500 and 3,200 yuan in rent respectively.
examples.zh: 我姐姐和我每个月的房租分别是 4,500 元和 3,200 元。

expressions.contrast_zh: 让两组信息一一对应，位置顺序绝对不能错：前者对前者，后者对后者。只比较两个数时直接写 A is higher than B 更清楚，respectively 留给成对或三组以上的数据。

expressions.head: closely followed by
expressions.pattern: A + lead + closely followed by + B

examples.en: In 2026, Nova led with 27 percent, closely followed by Aurora at 24.
examples.zh: 2026 年，Nova 以 27% 领先，Aurora 以 24% 紧随其后。

examples.en: Beijing is the busiest station on the line, closely followed by Shanghai.
examples.zh: 北京是这条线最忙的站，上海紧随其后。

expressions.contrast_zh: 用来讲排名第二紧咬第一，暗含差距不大；如果差距很大，用 followed by 就够了，加 closely 会失真。
